description: Section structure, section word caps and token budget for a feature document in docs/feat/. The prose authorities are docs/__meta__/feat.md section 4 for the structure and section 6 for the caps and the budget; this file is their machine-checkable half. It states what every feature document carries whatever its type: Summary, Table of Contents and Key Concepts open it, the optional sections keep their relative order, sections the document invents for itself follow them, and References closes it. Usage and Implementation are optional here for every type; which type requires or forbids them is a prose rule in feat.md section 4, checked by review, never a condition here. The word caps keep each section's prose concise: a word is a whitespace-delimited token of prose, and fenced code blocks and table rows are not counted, since examples and reference tables are what a feature document is for. A section's cap covers its H3 children, and the cap on the `any` run applies to each of its sections alone. Table of Contents and References carry no cap. The token budget is on the whole file, frontmatter, code and tables included: what loading it costs an agent, in o200k_base tokens whichever agent reads it.
